items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] How do you know Greg Caputo?

ctx.x: How do you know Greg Caputo?
We connected through an Arts In Education program and we ended up doing some school concerts with a program that I worked with in Central New York, and we backed up Joe Wilder on a little tour.
